sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text:
This is now a hybrid software and own-account securities business, not a clean high-margin SaaS stock. FY2026 software revenue rose 26.84% to₹19.7034 crore, while net trading gains₹4.5307 crore lifted reported operating revenue to₹24.2341 crore. Total income₹26.7798 crore is mislabeled as operating revenue in the annual-report highlights. PAT₹15.1983 crore coexists with CFO−₹10.8933 crore and financial-asset deployment. Deep assessment completed with an earnings-quality hold: BQS4.74, Growth Quality 5.95, IAS NS. Valuation requires segment/counterparty reconciliation and executable BSE data. [A26][RESULT]

Model correction dated20 October2026: opening obligations and terminal claims have been reconciled separately from new forecast expenses. Reported historical financial statements are unchanged. The corrected scenario values are in section10.

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Ace Alpha Tech Limited, BSE544431/ACEALPHA, INE0S9X01011, BSE SME; March shareholding explicitly says not listed onNSE. Formerly DM Prime Square Research & Analytics, incorporated 2012. Standalone Indian GAAP Accounting Standards financials. March closing shares 17558194, versus weighted EPS denominator; fresh IPO3548000 shares at₹69 provided₹24.4812 crore gross company capital. Offer-for-sale proceeds belong to selling shareholders, not the company. FY2025 bonus 1296-for-1 makes old unadjusted EPS incomparable. Annual listed promoter rows Arika 7465103 and Gaurav 243046 total 7708149/43.90%; the printed total 7564104 is arithmetically inconsistent. March declarations show no promoter pledge/other encumbrance or outstanding warrants/convertibles/ESOPs, not anOctober guarantee. [IPO][A26][SH][SEC] As of October 20, 2026; five-year analytical horizon, 15% nominal annual equity hurdle before investor tax, and ₹5 lakh reference position, not a recommended allocation. Segment inconsistency and unverified realized/unrealized/financial asset settlement bridge. G3 Survival: conditional. Debt-free and modeled stress funded, but financial asset liquidity/exposure limits unknown. G4 Implementability: hold. sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Software supplies institutional/retail trading, order and risk management, automation, strategy customization and support. Fixed maintenance/support is recognized over time; fixed-price projects use progress measured by effort. InSeptember 2025 shareholders expanded objects to proprietary securities and derivatives activity; financial trading now consumes capital and exposes the company to counterparty/market risk. FY2026 software₹19.7034, securities profit₹4.5958, derivatives loss₹0.0651; other income₹2.5457 includes interest₹2.1504, investment disposal gain₹0.1785 and fund income₹0.2168. There are no reported foreign-currency earnings. Revenue growth cannot be read as software recurring-revenue growth or gross exchange turnover. [A26][A25]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Trading-system integration, latency requirements and operational switching costs can support sticky relationships, but no independently verified renewal rate, recurring-revenue split or market share was found. Prospectus top 10 customers represented 100%/99%/67% inFY2022/23/24 and 82% in nine months toDecember 2024; top 5 were 84%/90%/43%/63%. Those dates matter: they are notFY2026 concentration. Software competes on reliability, integration and engineering; algorithm branding is not proof of a proprietary investment edge. Own-account trading earnings are cyclical and vulnerable to market microstructure, exchange controls and strategy decay. MOAT4, durability 5. [IPO][A26]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Software revenue FY2022–FY2026:₹0.3200/4.8926/14.8712/15.5341/19.7034 crore. Total operating revenue differs only inFY2026, at₹24.2341 because of trading. Prospectus restated PATFY2022/23/24₹0.1345/3.3231/10.6540; FY2022 original₹0.1376016 andFY2024 annual comparative₹10.3064 differ through tax/restatement presentation. Prospectus MD&A also gives a differentFY2024 PAT; use the restated statement rather than narrative. FY2025/26 statutory PAT₹11.1970/15.1983. FY2025 software growth was only 4.46%, followed by 26.84% FY2026; tiny pre-scale base inflates the three-year software CAGR near 59.1%. REV8 after short-history/comparability cap, with no bonus for adding trading. Raw pre-bonus EPS is excluded. [IPO][A22][A25][A26]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text:
JuneCARE monitoring identifies an approximately₹0.40 crore OFS-expense duplication in the prospectus budget. Shareholders approved reallocation to human resources effective 21 June 2026; fresh-issue cash did not increase. June revised capex allocation₹12.90, spent₹9.07, remaining₹3.83; acquisition/GCP₹8.12 fully used. Q1 spending₹1.90 comprised server facility₹0.74 and workforce₹1.16. The aggregate₹24.88 presentation includes seller-relatedOFS cost versus₹24.48 company fresh issue; do not create extra cash. March original remaining project budget was₹5.33; exact split of development capitalization, staffing expense and server spend needs reconciliation. Conditional software segment incremental after-tax return is about 11.67% using₹0.7795 incrementalEBIT and₹5.0107 incremental net segment assets, below an assumed 12–16% equity-capital hurdle. Segment allocation errors prevent high precision. CAP4, execution 4. [MON][A26]

Software revenue is growing again, server capacity and hiring can expand delivery, and minority investments may provide strategic technology access. Neither investment purchases nor own-account trading profits establish customer retention or incremental software returns. TheSeptemberAGM repeated the dual-business strategy and headline results; the registered speaker was absent and no substantive questions were answered. Useful catalysts are a reconciled segment note, collection/settlement of financial receivables, release of restrictedIPO cash after genuine deployment, evidence that development spending earns recurring revenue, and transparent position/counterparty limits. Do not capitalize projected trading alpha or general AI enthusiasm into a perpetual moat. [A26][MON][CALL]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Lalit Agarwal issued unmodified financial/IFC opinions and affirmative audit-trail reporting. IncomingS.Agarwal was appointed after the outgoing auditor second term expired, not an unexplained resignation. Gaurav ceased CFO duties inMay while remainingMD; Tejinder was appointedCFO. MD remuneration₹0.24 crore, disclosed related fees modest; financial loans are not identified as related-party balances. Reporting mistakes, financial-business expansion and limited trading-risk disclosure nevertheless constrainGOV4. September shareholders passed₹1000 crore borrowing/security and section 186 investment/loan authorizations; these are legal permissions, not existing debt or sanctioned liquidity. Prospectus discloses issuerGST nonfiling notice for 2021, promoter tax penalty proceedings and promoter-groupNarayan tax matters; later outcome not verified. No conviction, diversion or blanket clean-governance assertion. [A26][AUD][NOTICE][VOTE][IPO]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text:
Annual note 27 omits₹4.5958 crore securities profit from segment totals and applies the gratuity reversal with the wrong sign: it reports PAT₹10.5565 versusP&L₹15.1983. The issuer May 19 results has reconciling trading revenue₹4.5307, trading result₹3.8901 and correctPAT; therefore this is a later annual-table inconsistency, not an additional economic loss. Annual KAM discusses unrealized fair-value gains, while inventory policy says unlisted securities at cost and investments at cost unless permanent decline; realized/unrealized bridge remains unclear. Core PBT removing net trading, other income and₹0.023 gratuity reversal is₹13.2937; at 25% tax corePAT₹9.9703. Software-segment EBIT₹13.9383 gives₹10.4537 after tax, but cost allocation differs. Expensing all₹3.6976 in-house software development as an economic sensitivity lowers the first corePAT to₹7.1971; this is not a finding that capitalization violates standards. Full-share reported EPS₹8.6560 versus weighted₹9.13. EARN5 is a bounded judgment, not acceptance of headline margins. [A26][RESULT]

FY2026 CFO−₹10.8933 reflects receivables growth₹22.2167, securities inventory₹5.5303, other-current-asset increase₹0.8706, partly offset by liabilities₹3.2154. Cash tax₹4.9191. Cash capex₹10.1743 gives operatingFCF−₹21.0676, but loans/advances released₹8.9627 in investing cash flow. Do not infer software DSO from total₹23.6899 receivables: trading-segment assets₹29.3211 approximately match receivables plus₹5.5303 inventory. Exact allocation/settlement age is missing. Most total receivables are disclosed under six months, which is not proof of collection. FY2024 annualCFO₹10.0232 versus prospectus₹4.9953 reconciles approximately by moving₹5.9163 investments and₹0.8883 loan releases between operating/investing. FY2025CFO₹11.0916 looks strong, but₹18.5945 loan/advance outflow sat in investing. Historical cash classifications are not silently spliced. CASH4; persistent weak-cash cap is not imposed based on one new-trading year. [A26][A25][IPO]

March equity₹69.1430 crore, no reported debt, cash₹6.6686 including₹3 crore deposits. Financial pool includes investments₹15.2683, unlisted securities inventory₹5.5303, loans₹8.7216 and largely trading-associated receivables₹23.6899. Investments include quotedDSM/Indogulf, privateSilverleaf/uTrade andNandan fund units; these cannot all be valued or liquidated as cash. CARO describes demand loans without specified repayment period, while another clause says schedules are stipulated; unnamed counterparties/terms require evidence. Notes say no loans to promoters/directors/KMP/related parties, which limits but does not eliminate counterparty risk. BAL6 reflects debt-free solvency, discounted for illiquid/trading assets, restricted project cash and unknown open-position risks. No cash is inferred from a borrowing authorization. [A26][MON]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text:
Dated secondary October 19 close ₹154.60 replaces the older October 12 ₹165 reference. Equity value is ₹271.4497 crore: 17.86x reported PAT, 27.23x core PAT ₹9.9703, or 37.72x full-development-expense sensitivity. The attached five-year illustration values software earnings separately from financial assets, not trading gains at a software multiple. Base software growth 10/10/10/8/8%,65% pre-researchEBITDA, annualresearch 10% sales and explicit project/maintenance cash produces terminal₹145.66 and-1.58% illustrativeIRR; bull₹266.73/+11.08%, bear ₹36.01 is unfunded arithmetic, with no investable IRR. Financial assets receive explicit scenario haircuts, earn no assumed recurring trading alpha and are not liquidated to fund operations. Base and bull fund the selected assumptions; the corrected bear has a ₹2.4102 crore cash-reserve gap and no valid investor return. R remainsNS: exact software/financial asset allocation, current NAV/settlements, project cost split are not fully established; the price is corroborated only through a secondary source. These are illustrations, not targets. D3 reflects capital-loss risk rather than insolvency; P3 reflects demanding core-earnings expectations. [A26][MON][PRICE]

Model correction, 20 October 2026: this changes our cash-flow/terminal-claim treatment, not the issuer’s reported history. Pay the ₹3.4968 crore other current liabilities and ₹0.0001 crore current gratuity once. This conservatively settles the unallocated expense/customer/statutory balances rather than assuming a split between software and financial trading. Restore the prior ₹0.2481 crore financial-segment liability deduction once, because it is already within issuer liabilities; do not pay and deduct it twice. Retain noncurrent gratuity ₹0.0377 crore and a conservative deferred-tax reversal reserve ₹0.4058 crore at terminal, not as immediate tax. The ₹0.1814 crore net income-tax/TDS asset is not recovered. The reference price is the published19October secondary close ₹154.60, not the older ₹165 source snapshot. Corrected linked scenarios: Base: illustrative terminal price ₹145.66; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR -1.58%. Bull: illustrative terminal price ₹266.73; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR 11.08%. Bear: illustrative terminal price ₹36.01; peak funding gap ₹2.4102 crore; no investable IRR. [A26]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Software growth does not protect shareholders from losses or illiquidity in the financial-asset pool. The linked bear values investments/securities inventory/receivables/loans with 40%/50%/25%/30% haircuts, includes the explicit hypothetical ₹3 crore cash stress, and uses 10x software NOPAT. This corrected stress has a ₹2.4102 crore funding gap. The ₹36.01 terminal price is unfunded arithmetic, not an annual shareholder return; the previously reported funded-bear IRR is withdrawn. Those haircuts are scenarios, not proven impairments. Private valuations, settlement obligations and leverage limits remain unverified; a greater undisclosed exposure could produce a worse outcome. Failure to realize financial assets or reconcile the segment bridge is a thesis break.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At ₹154.60 and 1.7558194 crore shares, five/ten times equity value would be ₹1357.25/2714.50 crore. At an illustrative 20x recurring owner earnings, that requires ₹67.86/135.72 crore PAT, compared with ₹9.97 crore bounded core earnings. Trading gains cannot be assumed to compound at software margins; research spending, client renewal and financial-asset losses matter. No evidence supports assigning a multibagger probability.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text:
Official master corroborates 17558194 shares and 1000-share lot. At the dated secondary ₹154.60 close, one lot costs ₹154600 and three/four lots ₹463800/618400. Secondary history contains 44 observed rows in the 60-session window. L1 conditional: even the upper OHLCV turnover-bound observed-day median ₹478125 implies 20.92 sessions at 5% for ₹5 lakh; lower bound median ₹476250 implies 21.00. Missing days are excluded, not invented as zero. Provider completeness and BSE restrictions remain unverified, but any tighter restriction cannot improve this already-floor implementation score. Conditional missing-equals-zero lower median ₹396825 gives 25.20 sessions, but missing rows are not proven zero trades. Low/high times volume are bounds, not exchange turnover. No live spread/depth or current BSE surveillance clearance is asserted. IAS remains NS because R is unresolved; L is now bounded at 1 rather than unnecessarily NS.

Keep out of investable rankings underG2 hold until the annual/results segment bridge and realized/unrealized accounting are reconciled. Require counterparty/settlement detail for receivables and demand loans, cost/impairment support for private securities, development-cost andIPO-object reconciliation, and currentBSE execution data. Watch software-only growth and renewals, economicR&D burden, cash generation excluding financial-asset recycling, trading drawdown and liquidity, actual borrowing against new authorizations, dilution and cross-party transactions. A persistent inability to turn financial assets into cash or opaque leverage would worsen the assessment; transparent reconciliation and stable software cash economics could improve it. [A26][MON][NOTICE]

sections.text: Classification: hybrid software/financial-assets special situation, not a proven software compounder. sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Full downloaded annual reports, prospectus sections, Mayresults, CARE monitoring, AGM notice/result and transcript were read. Scanned March shareholding identity/declarations were visually checked; later tables were not fully extracted. This is a hybrid technology/financial-assets assessment: total turnover, inventory days and manufacturingCFO rules are not blindly transplanted. All forward growth, margins, tax, financial-asset haircuts, R&D/capex splits and cash shocks are analyst assumptions. Numeric quality factors are supported atMedium confidence; unsupported valuation/liquidity factors remain NS with exact weights and bounds. No automatic ranking from the undated input snapshot.
